questions: What is a heartbeat?
When a heartbeat stops, is it dead?
What is an election?
After an election, does one winner stay in charge?
What is a race?
If a race is close, does the faster one always win?
What is gossip?
If gossip spreads, does everyone eventually hear it?
What is recovery?
After recovery, is everything exactly as it was before?
What is a partition?
When a partition is removed, is everything back together immediately?
What is a barrier?
Once a barrier opens, does everyone go at once?
What is a lock?
If a lock breaks, can anyone get in?
What does commit mean?
Once a commit is made, can it be taken back?
What is consensus?
When consensus shifts, does the earlier decision change with it?
What is a queue?
When the queue is empty, has everyone been served?
What is a leader?
If the leader leaves, does the group automatically get a new one?
What is a checkpoint?
After a checkpoint, can you always go back to exactly that point?
What is a lease?
When a lease ends, is everything returned?
What is a stream?
When a stream ends, is there nothing left to come?
